sourceSkeleton.rotationMeaning: absolute canonical local rotation; retarget to target bind before export

rotationRule.targetLocal: T_local[i] = inverse(B_parent) * S_local[i] * B_i; B_rootParent = identity
rotationRule.BMeaning: Full measured target bind frame -> canonical rest frame. Target bind local/world quaternions are identity.
rotationRule.handConvention: canonical fingers -Y, palm normal +Z, contact guide point [0,-.08,.025]m; target palmar frame is measured from skin geometry
rotationRule.limitations: Per-role proportions differ. Imported rotations alone do not preserve ball contacts, foot plants or sole height. Apply ball/foot IK and vertex ground checks after retargeting and blending.
